ruleset.name: new-DH-user-site
ruleset.description: Template style gate: PSR-12, kept green via phpcbf. The excludes below are PSR-12 sniffs the template does not yet satisfy AND phpcbf cannot auto-fix (they need manual code changes). Remove an exclude once its code is cleaned up. (templates/*.tpl.php are mixed HTML/PHP and out of scope.) Clones inherit this file, so keeping it strict keeps every future site strict.
